changelog:
- Initial release of the Anime Manga Generator skill.
- Generate 2D/anime-style characters, scenes, storyboards, and illustrations, supporting style and character consistency across images.
- Supports text-to-image and image-to-image generation, style transfer, and batch creation for consistent manga material.
- Flexible prompt system includes control over character traits, styles, lighting, and composition.
- Includes tips for prompt optimization, maintaining style/character consistency, and handling multi-panel storyboards.
- Designed for personal creative use; not for real human portraits or prohibited content.
summary: 基于 image_generate 工具的二次元风格漫画/插画生成技能。支持角色设定、场景描述、分镜生成，可批量产出一致风格的漫画素材。
